subject: tu:game/sys/memcard
value:
IMAGE-WIDE CENSUS SETTLES THE 'GOTO-PAIR' CLASS: the unfolded two-edge branch terminator is SOURCE-SHAPE, NOT a missing compiler flag or pragma scope. Do not run another flag hunt for it.

THE SHAPE. An instruction at A branches to A+8 (conditional `bc`, or unconditional `b` when the guard folded away), and A+4 holds an unconditional `b` to the other edge. MWCC's branch cleanup normally folds this into ONE inverted conditional branch, which is what our builds emit; the GDL target keeps the unfolded pair at many sites. Recorded instances in game/sys/memcard: loadGauntletSave@0x9d4 (`b ->9dc` + a genuinely UNREACHABLE `b ->6c`, the CARDDelete switch's last leaf), get_vmu_directory@0x48 (`bne ->50` + `b ->54`, ours `beq ->54`), writeGauntletSave@0xe4 (`beq ->ec` + `b ->fc`, ours `bne ->fc`).

THE MEASUREMENT (LG_scratch/gotopair_census.py, run 2026-09-01 against build/GUNE5D/main.retail.dol sha1 7cba77aa..., joined to build/GUNE5D/report.json at All 98.31% fuzzy / 64.71% matched): 574 sites in the target .text; 563 of kind `bc`+`b`, only 11 of kind `b`+`b` (the truly-dead-second-edge variety, which is what loadGauntletSave has). 0 sites fall outside a known function. 274 sites sit in functions the project already scores 100.0 fuzzy, spread over 195 DISTINCT byte-exact functions across MSL (__kernel_rem_pio2, __kernel_tan), dolphin SDK (VIInit, VIConfigure, SIInterruptHandler, UpdateIconOffsets, __CARDVerify, Reset, OSResetSystem, entryToPath) and game code (check_player_atts, pbBlitSetDrawRegs, CamGetPlayerAvgPos, DoLighting, MBWindowProject, MBPsysSetEVolume, cardDoMount, ...). 300 further sites sit in 98 non-exact functions.

THE INFERENCE. Byte-exact functions containing the shape are, by definition, produced by the compiler with the flags configure.py ALREADY uses. Therefore MWCC under the project's current per-TU cflags emits unfolded two-edge terminators; nothing is missing from the flag set. This REFUTES the standing framing that a 'scoped config/pragma that fuses compares while keeping dead branches' has to be found, and it explains why `#pragma peephole off` was catastrophic (it is the wrong instrument, not a mis-scoped one) and why `#pragma opt_dead_code off` produced bit-identical output.

THE WORKED EXEMPLAR, same subsystem and same cflags_demo flags: cardDoMount (game/sys/cardutil, 100.0 fuzzy) carries three sites. Two of them (0xa0 `bge ->a8`+`b ->f0`, 0xc8 `bge ->d0`+`b ->f0`) come from source `s32 t = CARDGetSectorSize(...); if (t < 0) return t;` inside a switch arm - an `if` whose BODY IS A JUMP STATEMENT. The third (0x88 `beq ->90`+`b ->d0`) is a switch decision-tree leaf whose case arm is a real block. Both edges are LIVE at all three. So the generator's two-edge template survives when the taken edge leaves the block (return/goto) or lands on a real case body, and is folded when the `if` body is straight-line code that falls through.

CARRIERS MEASURED NEGATIVE ON get_vmu_directory@0x48 this run (its `if ((u8)beginSaveCacheTransaction() != 1) { success = 0; }`, whose body is an ASSIGNMENT and whose branch target is a JOIN block): one-case switch carrier `switch ((u8)beginSaveCacheTransaction()) { case 1: break; default: success = 0; break; }` folded to `cmpwi`+`beq` and additionally LOST the target's unsigned `cmplwi` (real 65 -> 67) - consistent with the four prior functions in the corpus where the one-case carrier folded (audioenternextstage, doaudiotallysfx, findworldobj, damage_enemy) and with claim.law.NV_ternary-cure-fails-when-branch-pair-target-is-a-join-block. The empty-then/populated-else arm swap was already negative (attempt.LG_get-vmu-directory-arm-swap.20260901.v1).

WHAT THE NEXT LANE SHOULD DO INSTEAD OF A FLAG HUNT: sample the 195 exact carriers, recover each one's SOURCE construct, and build the carrier dictionary keyed by (what the taken edge does: fall-through / jump-out / case body) x (what the branch target is: fresh block / join block). The two data points this record establishes are: jump-statement body + non-join target = KEEPS the pair (cardDoMount, verified byte-exact); assignment body + join target = FOLDS under every carrier tried so far (get_vmu_directory, 3 carriers). The census script is LG_scratch/gotopair_census.py (untracked; ~40 lines, re-derivable from this record's description).
